lead: Everything a finished video needs to be uploaded: title options, a description with chapters, tags and three thumbnails.

problem: The video is ready, but the upload stalls: you need a title, chapters by timecode, a description, tags and a thumbnail.
built: Three title options to choose from.
A description with chapters by timecode: 11 chapters in the sample.
A list of sources under the description.
Tags and upload settings: category, language, end screen, playlist.
Three thumbnail variants with different looks: pick one or test them on your audience.

steps: Titles, chapters and description are written from its content.
Three thumbnails are drawn in different looks.
You get one file and the images, ready for the upload page.
offer: Titles, a description with chapters, tags and three thumbnails, in one file and as images.
Text revisions; the number is in the service package.
